text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess gave it everything she had—and she delivered results.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm going to go sing "Aya Phantasia" now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If you fall asleep during the concert, I'll whack you.
So be sure to listen properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, your answer is perfectly fine!
Kawakami Princess belts out "Irodori Phantasia" with a powerful voice.
The crowd was in a massive frenzyâ

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone! Thank you so much
for coming to my stage tonight!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I had a great time too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My! And I have something
I would like to share with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I... next time, I...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"As a princess, I will take
1st place in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup~!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've wanted to be a princess ever since I was little!
I've been trying to become one...
And this is the stage where that dream will come true!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So, will you please cheer for me?
And when I come in 1st place, will you celebrate with me?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I'm really looking forward
to the next Queen Elizabeth II Cup. Sweep's running too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That's the one they were talking about on that show, right?!
A fierce battle between those two sounds super fun~!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that smug attitude?
Acting like she's the only one on stage.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She's not the only heroine here.
To me, that girl is just as much of one...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I will become the ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So please, everyone, join me on the path I forge!
I humbly ask you to follow my lead!!
